sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Optionally pass a typed route object, or specify typeof loader / typeof clientLoader as the generic.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: A route argument limits reads to that active path. The hook subscribes to the selected data; unrelated state changes do not force a data subscriber update. It does not start a request. A successful loader may itself return undefined.
